consequence.statement: HelmChart objects on source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected by schema validation.
consequence.remediation: Ensure HelmChart objects on source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 carry status.artifact.digest before applying them (e.g. let the controller set the artifact digest, then re-apply).

assertion.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema of helmcharts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, status.artifact.digest is now a required field, and HelmChart objects that omit it are rejected.
